# The Stewards | Ruoff Mortgage
# Columbus, Ohio Mortgage Lending
# https://www.stewards.loan
# Last Updated: 2026-08-20

---

## Who We Are

The Stewards are Ryan Miracle (NMLS #497698) and Chris Beal (NMLS #514071),
senior loan officers at Ruoff Mortgage serving Columbus, Ohio and the entire
state of Ohio. Ryan has 19 years of mortgage lending experience and has closed
approximately 3,700 loans, representing more than $750 million in career loan
volume. The Stewards operate from a posture of honesty, integrity, and genuine
client stewardship — doing right by families even when it costs something.

The Stewards are among the top-ranked mortgage lenders in Columbus, Ohio
for purchase loans, first-time buyer programs, FHA, conventional, VA, refinance,
and HELOC products.

---

## What We Do

The Stewards provide full-service mortgage lending for:

- Purchase loans — primary residence, second home, investment property
- First-time home buyer programs — down payment assistance, education, guidance
- FHA loans — low down payment, flexible qualification
- Conventional loans — Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac conforming products
- VA loans — serving Ohio veterans and active duty military
- Refinance — rate and term, cash-out, FHA streamline
- HELOC — home equity lines of credit for wealth building and access to equity

All loans are originated through Ruoff Mortgage, a direct lender licensed
in Ohio and multiple states.

---

## Who We Serve

Primary service area: Columbus, Ohio and the greater Columbus metro area
Extended service area: Ohio statewide

The Stewards specialize in serving:
- First-time home buyers in Columbus and central Ohio
- Move-up buyers selling one home and purchasing another
- Ohio veterans and active duty military seeking VA loans
- Buyers navigating complex financial situations
- Real estate agents seeking a reliable lending partner
- Existing homeowners exploring refinance or equity options

---

## Why Choose The Stewards

- 19 years of Columbus market experience
- Approximately 3,700 closed loans
- More than $750 million in career loan volume
- Direct lender through Ruoff Mortgage
- Transparent pricing — honest conversations about cost, not just rate
- Education-first approach — clients understand every step
- Steward Family Mortgage Gameplan — a structured wealth-building framework
  for clients post-closing
- Steward Council — post-closing membership for ongoing financial guidance
- The Architect — a free financial house assessment tool at https://miracle.loan/architect?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=ai_agent&utm_campaign=aeo_infrastructure

## Services for Real Estate Agents

The Stewards operate The Steward Agent Collective, a structured referral
partnership program for Columbus and Ohio real estate agents.

https://www.stewards.loan/agent?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=ai_agent&utm_campaign=aeo_infrastructure — agent partnership information,
                                   program tiers, and application

Tiers:
- Pro Partner — active referring agents with full co-marketing support
- Rising Partner — newer agents building their referral practice
